description: Source code for BMP581 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for power management, configuration, data fetching, and initialization.

methods.name: set_power_mode
methods.description: Sets the power mode of the BMP581 sensor, handling transitions and register updates.

methods.name: get_power_mode
methods.description: Retrieves the current power mode of the sensor from register.

methods.name: power_up_check
methods.description: Checks if the sensor's NVM is ready for operation.

methods.name: validate_chip_id
methods.description: Validates the chip ID of the sensor.

methods.name: soft_reset
methods.description: Performs a soft reset of the sensor.

methods.name: bmp581_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes like sampling frequency, oversampling, power mode, and IIR filter.
